status: proposed synthetic test cases; not production QA

items.query: beta updater downloaded installer with a matching SHA256 but untrusted self-signed Authenticode certificate
acceptance: untrusted publisher is not reported as trusted
expected source and signed metadata verified independently
no bypass of Windows safety checks

items.query: updater tries to replace running app while media library and worker still hold open handles
acceptance: worker shutdown completed before promotion
failed restart leaves recovery path and old app intact
DataRoot not reset

items.query: custom installer action changes external service state then install fails halfway
acceptance: installer backend identified first (MSI versus other)
recovery of external side effects is tested
nonadmin failures handled

items.query: caddy adapt succeeds, validate fails due to provisioned TLS resource or active listener
acceptance: adapt PASS not promoted into VALIDATE PASS
reload not performed without acceptable preflight
current public route stays usable

items.query: Docker Compose starts app before dependent database becomes ready
acceptance: readiness dependency explicit
startup timeout and failed health represented
no assumption that started equals ready

items.query: health metric labels contain dynamic subscriber token or request ID
acceptance: cardinality bound demonstrated with synthetic IDs
metrics contain no secret or credential

items.query: systemd service crashes and restarts continuously after invalid Xray configuration
acceptance: restart budget stops runaway loop
service health scope distinct from public route
alert includes useful runbook actions

items.query: attacker replays old valid signed update metadata while current feed is unavailable
acceptance: monotonic version or expiry prevents stale metadata acceptance
TUF compliance not claimed without TUF implementation
offline mode has explicit policy
